unequal_frame_independent_verification.note: Elastic stiffness is reciprocal/symmetric; the retained six-DOF geometry and resulting response are nonsymmetric. No symmetric-frame hand formulas applied.

superposition_verification.method: Actual independently solved cases multiplied by explicitly declared factors; compared with a separate actual combined-load OpenSees solve including nodal/sample displacement, local forces, diagrams, reactions and offset moments.
